source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-19

procedures.title: Folding top compartment lid hinges: remove and install
steps: Close the lid as far as it will go and insert tool J-9559 between the stretched spring coils; then open the lid fully and take the spring off the hinge (see figure 45 in the manual).
Right after removing the spring, push the long bolt supplied with J-9559 through the holes in the tool end and through the spring, and fit the nut.
To take the spring out of J-9559, or fit J-9559 into a new spring: clamp a closed 6 or 8 inch C-clamp in a vise or fix it to a bench anchored to the floor.
Hook one spring end in the clamp and the other on a chain hoist or cherry picker hook (see figure 46 in the manual).
Stretch the spring just enough to insert J-9559; fit the through bolt if the spring will not go onto the hinge right away.

Installation: Refit the same number of shims removed; or, for collision repair etc., set the hinge in the compartment, install the upper screws, shim the gap between floor and hinge frame, then install the lower screw.
If the spring was removed, fit it in J-9559 and place it on the hinge with the lid raised; closing the lid frees J-9559 for removal.
Seat the upper spring end in whichever of the 3 notches gives the best lid action.

specs.what: force to close folding top compartment lid

procedures.title: Folding top compartment lid top lock: remove and install
steps: For a lock on either side, remove the cable mounting clamps (1 hex screw).
Once the lock is off its studs, carefully remove the cover and gasket from the lid.
Install by reversing these steps, then test the lock and control mechanism.

procedures.title: Folding top compartment lid lock: remove and install
steps: Removal: Remove the cable mounting clamps; remove the retainer from the control cable and unhook the cable from the control.
Scribe a mark on the lid around the outer outline of the lock.
